name: secdeva/fieldTypes/deliveryModel

enumValues.enumDisplayValue: We deliver it (already on the EU market)
enumValues.enumDescription: We include a product that is already available on the Union market, whether from an EU manufacturer or through an importer who brought it in before us.

enumValues.enumDisplayValue: We import it into the EU and deliver it
enumValues.enumDescription: We are the first to place this product on the Union market, from a manufacturer established outside the Union.

enumValues.enumDisplayValue: We deliver it under our own name, or substantially modified
enumValues.enumDescription: Placing a product on the market under your own name or trademark, or modifying it substantially, makes you its manufacturer under EU product legislation.
We depend on it but never ship it. Part of the environment rather than of the delivery.

enumValues.enumDisplayValue: We use it to operate a service
enumValues.enumDescription: We run it ourselves, on infrastructure we are responsible for, rather than shipping it to anyone, so it is not placed on the market.

enumValues.enumDisplayValue: We consume it as a service
enumValues.enumDescription: A third party operates it and we use it over the network, such as a managed database, an identity provider or a payment API. We depend on it but never run or ship it, so it is not placed on the market.

description: What we actually do with this product, including who is responsible for operating it. Determines the planned economic operator role, where EU product legislation applies.
